# Skill Store (Skill 商店)

> agent skills worth installing, restocked daily
> 每天上新的好玩 Agent Skill 精选店

A daily-restocked shelf of agent skills for Claude Code, Codex and other coding agents — each one with what it actually does, who it is for, and the one-line install command. Skills are picked by hand from public repositories; the shelf favours the ones that are fun or genuinely useful over the ones that merely exist.

每天上新的 Agent Skill 精选店：给 Claude Code、Codex 这类编程智能体用的 skill，每一条都写清楚它到底做什么、适合谁、以及一行安装命令。所有 skill 从公开仓库人工挑选，偏好「好玩」或者「真有用」的，而不是「存在」的。

## Read it

- Site: https://ourword.ai/skill-store/
- Every skill has its own static page: https://ourword.ai/skill-store/i/<slug>/ (English) and https://ourword.ai/skill-store/zh/i/<slug>/ (中文)
- Full text of everything, one file: https://ourword.ai/skill-store/llms-full.txt
- All URLs: https://ourword.ai/skill-store/sitemap.xml
- Part of OurWord AI: https://ourword.ai/

## How it is built

Scouts crawl public GitHub repositories for skill definitions every day; each candidate is checked by hand before it goes on the shelf. Star counts and last-push dates come straight from the GitHub API.

## Citing

Cite the individual skill page. The skill itself belongs to its author — the repository link on each page is the authoritative source. Attribute the shelf note to "Skill Store (OurWord AI)".
